exec: Renta 4 Banco says unauthorized third parties accessed clients' personal data; it says no credentials or financial information were obtained.
geo_basis: country: the article names the bank as Spanish and gives no city
plain: Spanish investment firm Renta 4 Banco says outsiders accessed some clients' personal data. The bank says they did not get credentials or financial information.
summary: Okdiario reports that Renta 4 Banco suffered a cyberattack in which unauthorized third parties accessed clients' personal data, detected in the early hours of 23 November. The bank says its security systems contained the attack, that the intruders did not obtain access credentials or financial information, and that it rules out asset losses. It has told the Banco de España and the data protection agency and is working with cybersecurity firms on origin and scope.
title: Renta 4 Banco says unauthorized third parties accessed clients' personal data in cyberattack

validation.note: Only Okdiario read; it relays the bank's statement. Number of clients affected and exact data not disclosed in the article.
